relations.reading: A Tiger Team evaluation should include activation, learning and closure costs, while distinguishing necessary mission work from avoidable compensation.

relations.title: Admisibilidad contextual
relations.reading: Mission activation may respond to a change in operating assumptions, while remaining distinct from a formal regime-detection result.

relations.title: Capacidad humana utilizable
relations.reading: An intense intervention should end with recovery and transfer conditions that preserve the team's capability rather than treating sustained overload as proof of commitment.

relations.title: Custodia institucional
relations.reading: An institutional research mission can activate a bounded engineering contribution when funding, authority, source rights and evaluation responsibilities are explicit.

relations.title: Umbral de movilización
relations.reading: A mobilisation threshold may inform Tiger Team activation, but accumulated load must be read together with mission focus, authority, available attention and a credible exit.

relations.title: Capacidad interna después de la salida
relations.reading: The HRIS case illustrates a bounded architecture mandate whose successful exit is a usable transition to scaled delivery, rather than ownership of the entire rollout.
